worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.summary: Twist the air into a thin vortex and press out three short beats along a chosen direction; each beat bites only the first visible enemy along the ray, shoving it along the path, and a wall truncates the beam. It no longer bursts into a circular ring, and has a high critical-hit chance. Charge for greater power and reach, or use the quick-fire variant for tighter beats.
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.use.0: Pin a thin air vortex onto a distant line
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.use.1: Press three beats that only bite the first visible enemy along the ray
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.use.2: Point at one big target or a choke's front foe from afar
The three beats together deal about %1$s special damage across %2$s beats with a %3$s-block per-beat hit radius; each beat hits only the first visible enemy along the ray. This move has a heightened critical-hit chance.
The beam pins up to %1$s blocks along the locked direction, with %2$s between beats, and shoves the first target about %3$s blocks in total along the path; a wall truncates the beam.
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.charge.on: Charge form: power ×1.18, range +2.5 blocks and vortex body ×1.15, but +6 ticks wind-up, +2 recovery, +14 cooldown and beat interval ×1.15.
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.charge.off: Rapid form (default): beat interval ×0.85 and 8 ticks less cooldown, but power ×0.94 and slightly shorter range.
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.growth.0: From level %1$s the total vortex power rises to %2$s and range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.preference.c: On: power ×1.18, range +2.5 blocks and vortex body ×1.15, at +6 ticks wind-up, +2 recovery, +14 cooldown and beat interval ×1.15 — for leading a distant target. Off (rapid form, default): beats press tighter (interval ×0.85) and cooldown is 8 ticks lower, but power ×0.94 and range is slightly shorter — usable even up close.
worldcombat.skill.aeroblast.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. This is the longest-ranged move of the family, so a large value presses the beam first from far away.
On: when a foe drops below four tenths of its health this beam is preferred, to finish it. Off: health is ignored and it ranks as an ordinary ranged move.
